cells.scene: Two hands press firmly down on a spring-loaded platform, a blue downward arrow shows applied force.
Two nearly identical blue paint swatches differ only slightly in shade; a careful observer studies the small difference.

prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational. Create ONE SQUARE 2x2 atlas with four equal square cells for an adult vocabulary app. Attached image is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: restrained ink-and-watercolor educational illustrations, clear dark blue-charcoal outlines, pale blue wash, small warm natural color accents. Pure WHITE opaque background. Central 75% of each quadrant contains its subject with generous margins. Nothing crosses midlines. Leave horizontal 45–55% and vertical 47–53% center bands EMPTY WHITE. Natural human anatomy, recognizable objects, clear 320px silhouettes, restrained detail, no elaborate environment. NO captions, labels, writing, borders, grid lines, watermarks or logos. Only symbols or numerals explicitly requested in a cell are allowed. Meanings are guidance; never write them. Row-major fixed order. FOUR CELLS:
TOP LEFT — exert (v.施加): Two hands press firmly down on a spring-loaded platform, a blue downward arrow shows applied force.
TOP RIGHT — subtle (a.微妙的，难以捉摸的): Two nearly identical blue paint swatches differ only slightly in shade; a careful observer studies the small difference.
BOTTOM LEFT — advertiser (n.做广告的人): An advertising professional arranges product images on a large blank poster board, planning a campaign rather than stage announcing.
BOTTOM RIGHT — magic (a.有奇妙作用的): A plain cleaning cloth transforms a tarnished cup into a sparkling clean one in a before-and-after pair, surprisingly effective result.
Keep all primary subjects wholly inside each quadrant with generous white space.
review_notes: Reviewed correct textbook objects/actions and cell safety. subtle swatches need less contrast and are excluded for replacement.
